bbd04319deb6.reason: The finding incorrectly assumes the popstate handler will fire after a blocked navigation, but the browser prevents the popstate event from firing if history.back() is called and then blocked by a return false in a link handler, as the navigation never completes to trigger the event listener. Claude: a blocked click stops the event before any state change, so navHistory never runs and no history.back()/popstate happens; popstate only re-pushes when the user cancels leaving from a real back press.
